name: security-plugin
description: Security audit tools for Claude Code: OWASP Top 10 checks for AI agent skills and for ordinary applications. Install each check as its own plugin.

plugins.name: owasp-agentic-audit
plugins.description: Audit AI agent skills, Claude Code plugins, and MCP servers against the OWASP Agentic Skills Top 10 (AST01–AST10). Writes a dated report with findings, severity, and suggested fixes.

plugins.name: owasp-app-audit
plugins.description: Audit application code (web apps, APIs, backends) against the classic OWASP Top 10 (A01–A10). Writes a dated report with findings, severity, and suggested fixes.
